Important note

The AQRéseau+ product, distributed in the Adresses Québec range, is evolving and is now available under the name of [Quebec Land Transport Repository (RQTT)] (https://www.donneesquebec.ca/recherche/dataset/referentiel-quebecois-du-transport-terrestre). Consult the product sheet for up-to-date data. The web service associated with AQRéseau+ remains available in this sheet until the RQTT web service is online.

The transition of Adresses Québec products will continue until the end of 2026. For more information, see the [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)] document (https://diffusion.mern.gouv.qc.ca/diffusion/RGQ/Vectoriel/Documentation/AdressesQuebec/FAQ_Fin_diffusion_AQ.pdf).




Adresses Quebec is a road geobase that covers all of Quebec. It offers a complete road network including official names, addresses by slices and points, information for route management, postal codes (MOs) and a cartographic context.

The user guide is available at ** [next link] (https://diffusion.mern.gouv.qc.ca/diffusion/RGQ/Vectoriel/Documentation/AdressesQuebec/guide_utilisateurs.pdf) **.

For more information on the full range of products, refer to the ** [directory of web services and geographic data] (https://mrnf.gouv.qc.ca/ministere/cartes-information-geographique/repertoire-services-web-donnees-geographiques/) ** of the MRNF.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
